name: jira-mcp-ai
description: Jira Cloud over MCP: JQL search, issue reads, and writes behind a plan/apply gate.
long_description: Jira Cloud tools for Claude Desktop: JQL search, issue reads, comments, worklogs, boards and sprints. Read-only by default: write tools only describe the change until you set the write mode to "apply". The irreversible deletes are never offered here. No telemetry; the server talks only to your Jira site.

jira_email.title: Atlassian account email
jira_email.description: The account the API token belongs to. Used for Basic auth.

jira_api_token.title: Atlassian API token
jira_api_token.description: Create one at id.atlassian.com > Security > API tokens. Stored in the operating system's secure storage.

jira_write_mode.title: Write mode
jira_write_mode.description: "plan" (default) makes write tools describe the change instead of performing it. "apply" lets a call that passes apply: true execute. Leave it on plan unless you mean it.

jira_tool_packages.title: Tool packages
jira_tool_packages.description: Which tool packages to register: "all", "reader" (reads only), "core", or an explicit comma list.

jira_media_dir.title: Attachment directory
jira_media_dir.description: One directory the server may read and write attachment bytes in; it never touches anything outside it. Leave empty to keep attachment download and upload disabled — listing what is attached works either way.
